title: Configure tsa
description: Configure the TSA (RFC 3161 timestamp authority) module

host.description: Fully qualified domain name for the TSA, like 'tsa.example.org'

ip_allowlist.title: Client IP allowlist
ip_allowlist.description: Optional list of client IP addresses or CIDR networks allowed to reach the timestamp authority. An empty list (the default) leaves the service open to everyone. Each entry is validated as an IPv4/IPv6 address or network.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the HTTPS transport.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.
